query:
SELECT c.id as conv_id, c.title, c.createdAt, COUNT(m.id) as message_count
FROM conversations c
LEFT JOIN messages m ON c.id = m.conversationId
WHERE c.userId = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = 'test@example.com' LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 5;
